[[File:DejarikBoard-SWFF2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Holomonsters on a dejarik game board]]
'''Holomonsters''' were animated [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of creatures, used as playing pieces in the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]]. Creatures represented in this form included the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]], [[Grimtaash/Legends|Grimtaash]] the [[Molator/Legends|Molator]], [[Ghhhk/Legends|Ghhhk]], [[Houjix/Legends|Houjix]], [[Ng'ok/Legends|Ng'ok]], [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan strider]], [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]], and the [[M'onnok]].
